scope: Final consistency and localization review of the Admin panel; existing uncommitted work preserved.

Kept operator-entered notes and financial request IDs unchanged; translated their surrounding labels.
Displayed zero for absent additive metrics in completed report summaries, consistent with the breakdown and CSV.
Disabled First page consistently on the initial billing, storage, moderation and support pages.
Expanded source validation to include dynamic Admin label/description/title/text properties and balance labels.

additionalViews: Directory workspace tab and workspace detail
